active_only_for_matching_mouse_lookup_bi: Active only for matching mouse lookup bindings. Block opening links in a new tab, autoscroll, or history navigation in these locations.
accent_color_help: Used for buttons, links, and selected controls. Pick a color or enter a hex code such as #D26400.
audio_source_unavailable: This audio source could not be played.
popup_position_help: Automatic opens above or below the word, on the side with more space. Choose Below or Beside for another position.
delete_word_and_recording_confirm: Delete “{{lemma}}” and its recording? Review history is kept.
dictionary_tags_help: Checked tags mark matching words as Ignored. Dictionaries remain available. Set their color under Word colors.
dictionary_word_forms_are_used_no_extra_: Dictionary word forms are used. No extra Simplemma data is available for this language.
disable_individual_sites_from_the_toolba: Enable or disable individual sites from the extension toolbar.
does_not_limit_reviews_while_reading: Does not limit reviews while reading.
edit_this_sentence_the_encountered_word_: Edit this sentence. The encountered word must remain in it.
extension_description: Read with local dictionaries, save words, and review them with spaced repetition.
extra_word_forms_from_simplemma_help_fin: Extra word forms from Simplemma help find dictionary headwords. Downloaded during setup and kept on this device.
import_tatoeba_s_detailed_tsv_export_wit: Import Tatoeba's detailed TSV export with sentence IDs, language codes, text, and contributor names.
imports_replace_the_selected_category_ex: Imports replace the selected category. Export your progress before uninstalling.
includes_sentences_review_history_and_sa: Includes sentences, review history, saved audio, and immersion hit counts.
interface_language: Interface: {{language}}. English is used when a translation is unavailable.
invalid_audio_identities_in_learning_arc: Invalid audio identities in learning archive.
invalid_entry_in_choose_a_valid_yomitan_: Invalid entry {{value1}} in {{filename}}. Choose a valid Yomitan format-3 dictionary.
invalid_review_references_in_learning_ar: Invalid review references in learning archive.
invalid_word_identities_in_learning_arch: Invalid word identities in learning archive.
keep_this_page_open_until_the_import_fin: Keep this page open until the import finishes.
binding_capture_input: Click here to set a binding
binding_press_input: Press a key or mouse button…
lookup_binding_capture_help: Focus an input, then press a key or a mouse button over it. Use Hold key + hover for held keys; release modifier keys to finish. Escape cancels. Tab moves to the next input.
review_binding_capture_help: Click an input, then press a key or mouse button over it. Modifier combinations are supported. The clear button disables a binding. Escape cancels; Tab moves to the next input. These bindings work in study sessions and lookup popups. Hard and Easy are inactive when only Again and Good are enabled.
binding_used_by: This binding is already used for {{action}}.
review_binding_conflict: Use a different binding for each review action.
mature_interval_help: Young below this review interval; Mature at or above it.
nechybujte_online_help: Czech definitions online. Individual words are sent to Nechybujte when opened or during automatic loading. Full page text is not sent. Online dictionaries work best as secondary dictionaries. Place them below installed dictionaries and select “If needed” to reduce the risk of rate limiting.
nechybujte_response_unrecognized: The Nechybujte response could not be read.
spanishdict_online_help: Spanish–English definitions and examples online. Individual words are sent to SpanishDict when opened or during automatic loading. Full page text is not sent. Online dictionaries work best as secondary dictionaries. Place them below installed dictionaries and select “If needed” to reduce the risk of rate limiting.
spanishdict_rate_limited: SpanishDict has limited requests. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
spanishdict_response_unrecognized: The SpanishDict response could not be read.
no_additional_word_form_data_is_availabl: No additional word-form data is available for this language.
no_attributed_sentences_were_found_in_th: No attributed {{value1}} sentences were found in this file.
no_definition_is_available_in_the_enable: No definition is available in the enabled dictionaries.
no_examples_installed_for_this_study_lan: No examples installed for this study language.
no_local_voice_is_installed_install_a_sy: No local {{value1}} voice is installed. Install a system voice or enable pronunciation downloads.
no_tatoeba_download_is_listed_for_import: No Tatoeba download is listed for {{value1}}. Import a detailed TSV file instead.
no_voice_found_install_one_in_your_syste: No {{value1}} voice found. Install one in your system settings.
normalize_recording_volume_help: Even out recording loudness. System TTS uses device volume.
word_loading_help: Applies to all dictionaries for the selected language. Automatically loads words while scanning. When opened loads and colors words only when you use a lookup control.
parse_websites_automatically_help: Start parsing on websites by default. When off, enable individual sites from the extension toolbar. Site choices are saved.
press_a_key_or_key_combination: Press a key or key combination.
read_and_collect_words_in_your_study_lan: Read and collect words in your studied languages. Translate into your native language.
recording_missing: A recording is missing from the archive.
remove_your_saved_words_and_reviews_will: Remove {{title}}? Your saved words and reviews will stay.
replace_your_learning_data_with_words_re: Replace your learning data with {{length}} words, {{length1}} reviews, {{length2}} recordings, and {{immersion}} immersion dictionaries? This also replaces immersion hit counts and counted-block history. Export your current learning data first if you want to keep it.
replace_your_settings_with_this_file_dic: Replace your settings with this file? Dictionaries, words, and review history will stay on this device. If the scheduling model changes, review dates will be recalculated in all languages.
resume_this_word_before_grading_it: Resume this word before grading it.
save_a_word_from_a_website_to_add: Save a word from a website to add it here.
saving_replaces_the_dictionary_snapshot_: Saving replaces the dictionary snapshot for this card. Refresh from the dictionary to restore it.
secure_url_required: A secure HTTPS URL is required.
show_part_of_speech_on_card_fronts: Show part of speech on card fronts
tatoeba_examples_for_your_study_language: Examples for the selected language stay on this device. Finish setup downloads examples for all studied languages where available. Import accepts detailed TSV exports, including .bz2 files.
the_downloaded_dictionary_does_not_match: The downloaded dictionary does not match the installed dictionary.
the_extension_could_not_respond_reload_t: The extension could not respond. Reload this page.
the_system_voice_could_not_play_this_tex: The system voice could not play this text.
the_update_index_identifies_a_different_: The update index identifies a different dictionary.
this_action_is_only_available_inside_srs: This action is only available inside SrsReader.
this_dictionary_has_no_update_source: This dictionary has no update source.
this_lookup_expired_hover_over_the_word_: This lookup expired. Look up the word again.
this_review_is_no_longer_available_to_un: This review is no longer available to undo.
this_sentence_is_too_long_to_translate: This sentence is too long to translate.
this_word_changed_after_that_review_and_: This word changed after that review and cannot be undone.
this_word_changed_in_another_tab_reopen_: This word changed in another tab. Reopen it before grading.
this_word_has_no_dictionary_definition: This word has no dictionary definition.
this_zip_contains_no_terms_or_numeric_fr: This ZIP contains no terms or numeric frequencies.
this_zip_has_no_index_json_choose_a: This ZIP has no index.json. Choose a Yomitan format-3 dictionary.
auto_translate_sentences_help: Translate example and reading sentences into your native language when local translation is available.
auto_translate_definitions_help: Translate dictionary definitions into your native language when local translation is available.
translation_failed: Could not translate from {{source}} to {{target}} on this device.
translation_stays_on_your_device_models_: Translation stays on your device. Models download on first use. Chrome uses its built-in translator when available; Firefox uses Bergamot. Bergamot supports fewer languages.
try_another_dictionary_or_check_for_an_u: Try another dictionary or check for an update.
unmaster_this_word_before_reviewing_it: Unmaster this word before reviewing it.
use_your_lookup_control_on_a_word_on: Use your lookup control on a word on a website.
use_your_lookup_control_on_a_word_to: Use your lookup control on a word to save it.
used_for_sentences_and_missing_recording: Used for sentences and missing recordings.
srs_algorithm_ready: Scheduling model is ready. Review cards have been rescheduled.
rwkv_download_help: RWKV downloads from GitHub and works offline after download. Reviews stay on this device. Switching algorithms asks for confirmation and automatically recalculates review dates in all languages.
rwkv_download_failed: Could not download the RWKV model. Try again.
rwkv_invalid_package: The RWKV model package is incomplete or its checksum is incorrect. Download it again.
rwkv_not_ready: RWKV must rebuild its saved state before you can review.
rwkv_preparing: Preparing RWKV. Downloading the model if needed…
rwkv_mode_help: Curve uses the forgetting curve saved after an answer. Instant queries recall at future review dates and can take longer. Its interval cannot exceed the Curve interval. Both use your desired retention. Switching modes asks for confirmation and automatically recalculates review dates in all languages.
rwkv_ready: RWKV is ready for offline reviews.
srs_steps_help: Separate steps with spaces. Use m, h, or d, such as 1m 10m. Leave empty to use the model interval.
srs_invalid_steps: Use positive steps with m, h, or d, separated by spaces.
srs_learn_ahead_help: When the queue is empty, allow steps this many minutes early. With a 10m step and a 20m limit, a card can appear again immediately. Set 0 to wait.
srs_single_step_help: With one 10m step, Good graduates a new card immediately. Again waits 10 minutes; Hard waits 15 minutes.
srs_new_gather_help: Pick words up to your daily limit.
srs_new_sort_help: Keep that order or shuffle the chosen words.
srs_new_review_help: Show new cards before, mixed with, or after scheduled reviews and interday learning.
srs_interday_review_help: Place learning and relearning steps that crossed a study-day boundary before, mixed with, or after regular reviews.
srs_review_sort_help: Sort regular reviews before applying the daily review limit. Due date puts older due dates first.
srs_display_order_help: Due same-day learning steps always come first. Random order stays stable within the study day. Mix keeps each group's order and chooses between groups in proportion to their remaining cards.
srs_limit_help: Leave empty for unlimited reviews. The limit also stops new cards. Same-day learning steps remain available. Reading ratings still count.
srs_frequency_retention: Set retention by word frequency rank
srs_rank_help: Select dictionaries that contain ranks: 1 means the most frequent word. Do not select occurrence counts. Selected ranks are combined. Words without a rank use global retention.
srs_invalid_bands: Use increasing rank limits and retention from 70% to 99%.
srs_leech_help: 0 disables detection. Only Again on a normal review counts as a lapse. Repeated Again during relearning does not add lapses.
srs_reschedule_help: Apply current retention and interval settings to active review cards in this language. New, learning, mastered, and suspended cards stay unchanged. This does not add reviews.
srs_override_help: 70–99%. Leave empty to use frequency rules or global retention.
undo_latest_only: Only the latest answer across all tabs can be undone.
settings_setup_intro: Choose your languages, add a dictionary, and set up a lookup shortcut.
udpipe_help: Sends text in supported studied languages to LINDAT for grammar analysis. Successful results stay cached in this browser. If the service fails, local parsing is used for 10 minutes. LINDAT may use submitted text to improve its systems. Models are for noncommercial use.
udpipe_permission_denied: Permission to send page text was not granted. Local parsing remains active.
ignore_proper_names_help: Uses the Ignored appearance for names recognized by UDPipe. Saved word states take priority. Nationality words are excluded. Names remain searchable and are not saved as ignored.
dictionary_display_help: Show always includes the dictionary. If needed includes it only when dictionaries above have no entry. Hide disables it.
srs_queue_ahead: Ready early: {{count}}. Included in Learning and Relearning.
srs_heatmap_today_partial: Answers today: {{answers}} · Recorded time: {{minutes}} min ({{timed}} answers with timing)
dictionary_grammar_conflict: {{feature}}: the dictionary says {{dictionary}}; the parser says {{parser}} in this sentence.
definition_senses_hint: Use one line for each sense. Blank lines are skipped.
udpipe_model_help: Choose the training corpus that best matches your reading. The choice is saved separately for each study language.
udpipe_corpus_czech-cac: News, nonfiction, academic texts, reviews, and legal texts.
udpipe_corpus_irish-idt: Fiction, news, web content, legal texts, and government texts.
udpipe_corpus_irish-twittirish: Irish-language tweets from two Twitter corpora.
udpipe_corpus_korean-ksl: Essays written by learners of Korean.
udpipe_corpus_latin-perseus: Classical Latin literature, historical prose, and biblical texts.
udpipe_corpus_latin-ittb: Medieval Latin nonfiction from Thomas Aquinas and related authors.
udpipe_corpus_portuguese-cintil: Mostly news, with fiction, nonfiction, and grammar examples.
udpipe_corpus_portuguese-porttinari: Brazilian Portuguese news texts from the Porttinari corpus.
udpipe_corpus_romanian-rrt: Literature, legal texts, medicine, news, and other prose.
udpipe_corpus_romanian-simonero: Medical books, articles, and blogs about cardiology, diabetes, and endocrinology.
udpipe_corpus_russian-taiga: Fiction, blogs, social media, news, poetry, and Wikipedia.
udpipe_corpus_russian-poetry: Russian poetry from the 19th to the early 21st century.
udpipe_corpus_ukrainian-iu: Fiction, news, letters, web content, and other Ukrainian texts.
udpipe_corpus_ukrainian-parlamint: Transcripts of plenary sessions of the Ukrainian parliament.
audio_sources_order_help: Enable sources to download recordings when playing or saving a word. Only the word is sent. Disabled sources are not contacted. Saved recordings remain available.
drag_to_reorder_help: Drag a handle to change the order. You can also focus a handle and press Up or Down.
srs_switch_model_confirm: Switch the scheduling model and recalculate review dates for all review cards in all languages? This includes suspended and mastered cards. New and learning cards keep their current steps. Review history stays unchanged.
study_overview_help: Open a language to review its decks, or open one deck. Each session contains one language. Daily limits apply separately to each language.
study_deck_not_found: This deck is not available for the selected language.
frequency_deck_help: Use the first N unique entries with letters. Skip saved words and entries without definitions.
frequency_deck_dictionary_missing: Install and enable a frequency dictionary for this language in Settings → Dictionaries.
study_invalid_decks: The learning archive contains invalid deck references.
study_invalid_sentences: The learning archive contains invalid cached sentences.
study_no_cached_sentence: No cached sentence longer than four words is available for this word yet. Parse more pages in this language.
study_sentence_loading: Finding sentences in the reading cache…
study_reveal_hint: Click Show answer or press Space to reveal the answer.
frequency_deck_no_new_words: No new words with definitions were found in these entries. They may already be mined or in another deck.
study_clear_deck_confirm: This deletes all saved words in this deck and their downloaded recordings, including mastered and suspended words. The empty deck, review history, and cached sentences are kept. This cannot be undone.
study_delete_deck_confirm: This deletes the deck and all its saved words and downloaded recordings, including mastered and suspended words. Review history and cached sentences are kept. This cannot be undone.
words_empty_deck: This group has no saved words. Add words while reading or create a frequency deck in Study.
words_no_matching_filters: Change the search or status filter to see more words.
dictionary_search_help: Search enabled, installed dictionaries. Match part of a word or reading, or choose Definition to search by meaning. Press Enter or Search.
dictionary_search_no_dictionaries: No enabled definition dictionaries for this language. Install or enable one in
dictionary_search_no_matches: No matching entries. Try different text or another language.
custom_definition_override_help: This custom definition appears on this card and in popups. The dictionary entry stays unchanged.
language_settings_for_help: Choose a language for dictionaries, parser models, audio, or maintenance. General review settings apply to every studied language.
studied_reading_help: Automatically detects and parses text in your studied languages. Short passages can use the page language. Text in other or unidentified languages is skipped.
immersion_collection_help: Counts website words while enabled. Disabling stops counting and keeps saved hits and ranks.
immersion_score_help: Score = primary hits + multiplier × secondary hits. Use 0–1, with up to two decimal places. Default: 0.3. Changes save when you leave the field or press Enter.
invalid_immersion_archive: The learning archive contains invalid immersion counts or passage records.
frequency_enabled_help: Enabled dictionaries contribute word ranks. Disabling Immersion Frequency also stops counting and keeps saved hits.
